svg.aria-label: Dragging the wavelength line changes one analysis variable; only the nodes that depend on it run again, all others are reused, and the plot replaces just the line that moved.

svg.text: Drag the λ line in a plot: the view changes its own parameter.

svg.text: That parameter is bound to the analysis variable λ, so every node bound to it gets the new value.

svg.text: Quantum yield now has different parameters, so a different fingerprint: it runs in a worker process.

svg.text: The others see the same inputs and parameters as before: their stored results are reused.

svg.text: The view keeps every mark that did not change and replaces only the one that moved.
